questions.stem: The price of a brand of shoes increases by \(10\%\) per annum. A customer buys one pair of these shoes each year for \(10\) years. If the total paid over the \(10\) years was \(920\) dollars, find the initial price of the shoes (correct to the nearest cent).
questions.hint: Set up the geometric series representing the purchases, write the expression for S_10 in terms of P, and solve for P.

steps.explain: Represent the price paid each year as a geometric progression.
Set up the sum of the first 10 terms in terms of P.
Substitute the total paid into the equation and solve for the initial price P.

questions.stem:
In a composite simulation of Deep-space communication link, the signal power attenuation rate is recorded sequentially. The readings alternate between two distinct geometric progressions:
\(4,\, 6,\, 16,\, 18,\, 64,\, 54,\, \dots\)
Find the sum of the first \(8\) terms of this combined series.
questions.hint: Separate the series into two independent geometric progressions of 4 terms each: one consisting of the odd-indexed terms and the other of the even-indexed terms.

steps.explain: Identify and separate the odd-positioned and even-positioned terms into two separate geometric series.
steps.work:
\(\text{Odd series: } 4 + 16 + 64 + \dots \implies a_1 = 4, r_1 = 4\)
\(\text{Even series: } 6 + 18 + 54 + \dots \implies a_2 = 6, r_2 = 3\)

steps.explain: Calculate the sum of the first 4 terms of the odd-indexed geometric series.
Calculate the sum of the first 4 terms of the even-indexed geometric series.
Combine both sums to find the total sum of the first 8 terms.
